races.paceDynamic: Frankies Fortune and Kayla's Friend will dispute the early lead, with both confirmed front-runners likely to set a solid gallop over this extended trip. Lowlands and Hunters Spring should track them prominently, while the majority of the field including Kaydence, Bracing Brook and Quinnfinity will settle towards the rear. The dual pace angle creates an honest tempo that will test stamina over the final half-mile. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers and those with tactical speed to position close to the pace, as the leaders may weaken late but hold-up horses face a tough task from too far back.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Leaders Collapse Late
scenarios.trigger: If both Frankies Fortune and Kayla's Friend set too strong a pace early
scenarios.body: The pace-setters weaken significantly in the final furlong, allowing prominent racers who tracked them to sweep past. Horses like Lowlands and Hunters Spring benefit from the perfect stalking position.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: One Leader Survives
scenarios.trigger: If either Frankies Fortune or Kayla's Friend gets first run on their rival
scenarios.body: The surviving leader kicks clear turning for home while their pace rival fades, holding off late challenges. The winner combines early pace with stamina reserves over this trip.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Charges
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is moderate and the field stays together longer
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where tactical speed matters more than position, suiting horses with finishing kicks. Kaydence and Bracing Brook can utilise their class advantage.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Benefits
scenarios.trigger: If the market principles fail to fire and get in each other's way
scenarios.body: A lightly-raced improver or overlooked runner capitalises on the chaos ahead to strike at decent odds. Poppies In July's unknown quantity status could prove crucial.

races.paceDynamic: Newtown Rambler and Hypotenus will dispute the early lead with both confirmed front-runners likely to press on at a solid gallop over this sharp 2m trip. Dance Thief and Mister Cessna should sit prominent behind the leaders, while the three hold-up horses (Garde Des Champs, Next Twist, Shadowfax Of Rohan) will face a significant tactical disadvantage. The sustained early pace and short distance will create a strong tempo that burns off the leaders' kick, but leaves insufficient time for closers to mount their traditional late challenges. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners who can track the pace and kick when the leaders tire.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Pounces
scenarios.trigger: If Dance Thief or Mister Cessna positions perfectly behind the dueling leaders
scenarios.body: The front two burn each other out in a genuine gallop, allowing the prominent tracker to strike decisively in the final furlong when the pace takes its toll. This tactical advantage proves decisive over the sharp 2m distance.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If either Newtown Rambler or Hypotenus gains a decisive early advantage over their rival
scenarios.body: The leader settles into a rhythm without excessive pressure, conserving energy for a final kick that the hold-up horses cannot match over this insufficient trip. Superior pace judgment and tactical position triumph.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Rally Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes exceptionally strong and both leaders fade dramatically
scenarios.body: Next Twist or Garde Des Champs produces a spectacular finish from the back, capitalizing on a collapse up front. The hold-up horses need everything to fall perfectly given the tactical disadvantage.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If all three front-runners (leaders plus Dance Thief) hit the wall simultaneously
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where the best finisher from the back division can sweep past tiring rivals. Only extreme circumstances create this opportunity for the hold-up brigade.

races.paceDynamic: Manowest is the only confirmed front-runner with a prominent style, likely to dictate terms alongside fellow prominent runner Ebselysees and Shoeshine Boy. With most of the field preferring hold-up tactics, this creates a sustainable pace scenario where the leaders won't be pressured early. The majority hold-up brigade including Lady In The Park, Buy Some Time, Suspected, and Fairlawn Skipper will be relying on late kicks over this stamina test. This race shape strongly favours horses that can either sustain a steady gallop from the front or those with proven finishing kicks who can capitalize on the likely moderate early pace.

scenarios.body: The lack of early pace pressure allows the leader to control fractions and kick clear when the hold-up horses are still getting organized. Proven front-runners with stamina reserves can exploit the tactical disadvantage of the trailing pack.

scenarios.label: C

scenarios.trigger: If Ebselysees or Shoeshine Boy can track Manowest perfectly

scenarios.label: D

scenarios.trigger: If all the prominent runners go too slowly early
scenarios.body: The entire field comes into contention in the final furlong creating a messy sprint where any horse can win. Fitness and jockey tactics become the determining factors rather than class.

This tactical setup strongly favours the front runner and any prominent racers who can avoid the traffic problems that will inevitably develop among the massed hold-up horses.
